title: Case 008: Check-Out Works
initial_request:
Following the tenant vacating please provide an estimate to; 
Repaint bedroom any other rooms if needed
Replace bedroom carpet that is burnt
Replace bathroom flooring 
Repair broken plug 
Repair dripping bath tap 
Repair damaged shelf in bathroom
overview: After the tenant vacated, the manager requested an estimate to repaint the bedroom and any other rooms if needed, replace a burnt bedroom carpet and the bathroom flooring, and repair a broken plug, dripping bath tap and damaged bathroom shelf. The landlord requested a second quote for comparison. Following quote follow-ups and discussion of an outstanding invoice for earlier work, the landlord approved the lower quote from Eliza Bennett; the provider agreed to proceed. The work was completed, and an invoice was sent to the landlord. The tap did not need replacing, reducing the final cost from the original quote. No photos were attached, and the request was closed after checks were completed. The landlord later approved payment.
outcome: The requested works were completed, and the final cost was lower than the original quote because the tap did not need replacing. The invoice was sent to the landlord, who approved payment.
